class.name: SteamTimelineOperation
class.brief_description: Observes one lookup for Steam Game Recording footage associated with a Timeline event.
class.description: Observes one lookup for Steam Game Recording footage associated with a Timeline event.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Ends this local observation and settles it with [constant ERR_SKIP].

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns true once the lookup reaches a terminal result.

method.name: result
method.description: Returns the settled result or null while the lookup is pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Returns the settled result immediately or a signal that resolves to a [SteamBoolResult].

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once with the settled recording lookup result.
